reviews.comment: Did not grade a single final deliverable. Told us "extra time, extra polished report" and then proceeded to never look at it, and just gave the entire class an A on howdy. Probably the worst experience I have ever had at TAMU. Does not support our projects and instead focuses on abstract textbook knowledge like the "nth-dimensional hyperspace"

So many complaints, but the entire experience can be summed up with this:

Final Semester Report Assignment (posted 12/12 at 8:45am, due at 12:30pm):

"NOTE 1:  The points shown may change depending on the rubric and changes to it. The max points could range from 90 pts to 200 pts.  Final score will ultimately be presented as a percentage."

(Sadly limited to 350 characters). This is the worst professor here at A&M, and honestly A&M should get a refund for paying him. Only two things have been graded (and clearly by AI), did not review our drafts, posts assignments with 0 warning (on a Sunday even) and 0 time to do them, no project for weeks, project "sponsor" doesn't even know him
